info.title: Spotify Play Count & Monthly Listeners Scraper
info.description:
Spotify scraper for play counts and monthly listeners: paste a track, album, playlist or artist link and get every track's play count, plus an artist's monthly listeners and followers. Optional streams per day. No login. Pay per track.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/spotify-play-count-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/spotify-play-count-scraper
Author: Public Records.
